extraction.Name: Peter Pourier
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee to his allotment, on account of not wishing to pay taxes, but was told by the Indian Agency that he would have to take it, so he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged his allotment to the Hot Springs Clinic, at Hot Springs, South Dakota, for $550.00; and that it was foreclosed on in 1926
extraction.Buyer: State Bank of Scenic, South Dakota had purchased the papers from the Hot Springs Clinic; foreclosed in 1926
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: it being heavily indebted for taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: chief source of revenue at present is working for the United States Government, as Assistant Farmer, on the Pine Ridge Reservation
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health generally good but suffered a broken leg in 1925 by a saw log rolling on it and will always be a cripple from it; for about a year after the accident received $55.00 per month from F.L. Nihart of Pringle, South Dakota, for whom he was working at the time of the accident; has a wife and seven minor children to support; family all have good health; close living on his salary for his large family; had a chance to repurchase the place through the Indian Agency but the State Bank of Scenic would not surrender the papers, wishing to retain the land; has never received any help from the County or Government; document sworn in 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Reservation" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
